text: Interactive manual gating SingleCellExperiment objects R. Open-source flow cytometry CyTOF (mass cytometry) gating app R — FCS import, fluorescence compensation, hierarchical population trees, Gating-ML exchange, persisted inside object. 📖 Documentation & Getting Started GateLabR runs TypeScript/React interface GateLab, backed thin R host hand-gating flow cytometry mass cytometry (CyTOF) data directly SingleCellExperiment objects. slots Bioconductor-based analysis pipelines (e.g. CATALYST, diffcyt) events already live R SCE want fast, reproducible alternative round-tripping FlowJo Cytobank just draw gates. Gates drawn interactive D3.js canvas. Gates, populations, scales, assay bindings, compensation provenance illustration settings persist SCE via metadata(), explicit commands write panel labels rowData() population, division sample annotations colData(). style manual gating directly FCS files without R installation, see GateLab, companion browser app. GateLabR better fit data already live SingleCellExperiment gated populations need return directly colData Bioconductor pipeline.

title: GateLabR — interactive gating for SingleCellExperiment objects
text: Draw edit gates interactively. Polygon, rectangle quadrant gates pair channels, click--drag vertex editing, undo / redo, per-gate colour label. Positive population trees. Build hierarchies populations gate references — population intersection () gates within parent; counts percentages update live. Flow CyTOF modes. Auto-detects instrument type channel names. Flow uses per-channel logicle fluorescence arcsinh FSC / SSC scatter, editable W cofactor; CyTOF channels use arcsinh (cofactor 5). Flow CyTOF compensation. Inspect, edit, sweep apply spill matrices shared Compensation tab. GateLabR performs durable calculation R, installs revisioned full-size SCE assay atomically, preserves original assay, restores saved compensated assays without recomputation. Existing compensated SCE assays can adopted directly. Cytobank-compatible Gating-ML 2.0 import / export. Round-trip supported gates positive population trees Cytobank ISAC Gating-ML 2.0-compliant tools. Files containing populations, gates whose channels matched loaded data, rejected import rather partially silently altered. (FlowJo uses .wsp format round-trip Gating-ML.) Workspace persistence. Gates, populations, scales, active assay, compensation provenance illustration settings saved inside SCE re-loaded automatically. FCS export. Export gated populations FCS files, optionally split sample_id. Sample filter multi-sample overlay. Filter colData column overlay multiple samples distinct colours. Statistics tab. Per-population, per-channel summary stats (count, % parent / total, median, mean, geometric mean, SD, CV) exportable CSV. Cell-division profiler. CFSE / CellTrace dye-dilution tab: draggable per-sample division gates 1-D histogram (Div0…DivN), marker-vs-dye biplot density contours, per-cell division calls written back colData. Composition preview. Proportions tab quick stacked-bar boxplot previews colData composition (e.g. cluster division proportions condition), per-sample averaging faceting. Figure export. Strategy Illustration tabs render publication-style multi-panel grids. Illustration includes biplot histogram grids, stacked ridgelines, population--channel median / mean expression heatmaps per-channel, per-population z-score scaling three colour palettes. SVG export uses gridSVG produce Adobe Illustrator-friendly grouped vector files (rasterised data, vector axes / gates / labels).

what: How GateLabR compares with other tools
title: GateLabR — interactive gating for SingleCellExperiment objects
text: GateLabR fills specific gap: interactive GUI gating lives natively SingleCellExperiment, slots Bioconductor pipeline instead replacing — keeping full R access object. Note Gating-ML row: two dominant GUIs, Cytobank exchanges ISAC Gating-ML 2.0 — FlowJo (uses .wsp format). GateLabR speaks Cytobank-compatible Gating-ML, supported gate geometry positive population trees move losslessly GateLabR Cytobank. Broader Boolean logic may considered future update user demand. FlowJo trademark Becton, Dickinson Company. GateLabR independent project affiliated endorsed BD FlowJo. GateLabR suits two workflows. data already lives R SingleCellExperiment, lets gate without round-tripping FlowJo Cytobank hand populations straight diffcyt / CATALYST. ’s equally home plain FCS-→ gate → FCS / stats / Gating-ML tool: import .fcs files, gate interactively GUI, export — R fluency needed beyond one line launch .
